name: ai.dualsoft/aas
title: DualSoft AAS & PLC (DS Studio)
description: Read-only MCP for DualSoft AAS 3.0 / AASX specs, DS2 PLC control docs, and 3D line examples.

tools.name: dsdx.start
tools.description: START HERE on this public read-only DS Studio MCP: call with {} or an optional goal (max 500 chars) and languageVersion ('ds2/v2' default or 'ds2/v1'). Returns an official starter .ds2 example, reference metadata, and next read-only lookup steps; actual .ds2 compilation, verification, and PLC conversion run locally in DS Studio (/play) or Local MCP rather than uploading customer code. Use first to orient on docs, examples, and 3D library tools; use dsdx.ping for bare health checks or dsdx.examples.list to browse all starter examples.

goal.description: Optional goal, at most 500 Unicode characters. Hint only; returns an official example.

languageVersion.description: Starter profile: ds2/v2 (default ST expression example) or ds2/v1 (legacy example).

tools.name: dsdx.ping
tools.description: Check MCP server liveness, product version, active spec/protocol metadata (DS2-SPEC-V2.0, DSDX-MCP/1.0), and live buildCommit. Accepts an optional echo string reflected in the response. Use for quick health or version checks; use dsdx.start instead for onboarding workflow guidance and starter examples.

tools.name: docs_search
tools.description: Search official DS Platform specifications, guides, wiki pages, contracts, and examples by keyword, category, and spec version (DS2-SPEC-V2.0 default or DS2-SPEC-V1.1). Accepts optional query (equivalent aliases: q, keyword, search, term; empty query lists top public documents), category, version, and limit. Use first to discover matching document_id values before calling docs_read; use dsdx.examples.list to browse starter .ds2 files or dsdx.library.search for 3D equipment models.

query.description: Optional search query keyword or phrase across canonical repository docs, grammar, contracts, examples, and wiki (omit, empty, or '*' returns full Diataxis catalog)

version.description: Target documentation/language version ('DS2-SPEC-V1.1' / 'ds2/v1' or 'DS2-SPEC-V2.0' / 'ds2/v2'; omit or 'latest' for V2-first search with explicitly labelled legacy references)

limit.description: Maximum number of matching sections to return (default: 15, max: 50)

includeCategories.description: Include Diataxis category descriptors (default: false in summary view)

tools.name: docs_read
tools.description: Read one known DS Platform document (full text or a single heading section) with TOC, code examples, sourceUrl, specVersion, and buildCommit. Pass document_id (equivalent aliases: id, doc_id, docId, documentId, path, file; document_id takes precedence), optional section, and view ('full' default for body text or 'summary' for metadata/TOC); unknown IDs return an error listing valid document_id values. Use after docs_search when you know the document_id; use docs_search instead when discovering documents by keyword.

document_id.description: Canonical document ID or relative path (e.g. 'SPEC-00', 'SPEC-04', 'ST-EXPR-SPEC', 'AI-ST-KIT', 'AI-KIT', 'AI-IMAGE-KIT', 'STUDIO-3D-KIT', 'DS2-LANG-SPEC', 'grammar/ds2-v1.ebnf', 'grammar/ds2-v2.ebnf', 'contracts/diagnostics.json', 'examples/01_chain.ds2', 'wiki/home')

docId.description: Short alias for document_id; provide the same identifier if combining aliases

section.description: Optional section heading number, title, or anchor to read (omit or '' for full document)

includeExamples.description: Whether to include starter and preset .ds2 examples

includeExampleSource.description: Whether to include full .ds2 source text for examples even in summary view

exampleId.description: Optional specific example filename or ID to retrieve with source

tools.name: dsdx.examples.list
tools.description: List official DS2 starter and tutorial examples (basic, tutorial-basic, intermediate, xg5000-demo-kit, advanced, carwash, st-conditions-v2, robot-assembly-cell-v2) with localized titles and metadata. Filter results with optional query (alias q), category ('fixture', 'st-expression', 'legacy'), lang ('ko', 'en', 'de', 'ja'), or languageVersion ('ds2/v2', 'ds2/v1'). Use to discover available example IDs before fetching full .ds2 source with dsdx.examples.get; use docs_search for reference specifications.

query.description: Optional keyword filter across id, alias, and title

tools.name: dsdx.examples.get
tools.description: Fetch the full official .ds2 source code, syntax notes, and metadata for a single starter example by id (equivalent aliases: exampleId, filename, key, name, example; id takes precedence) and optional lang ('ko', 'en', 'de', 'ja'). Missing or unknown id returns a validation error listing valid example IDs. Use after dsdx.examples.list when you need runnable DS2 code for /play or local editing; use dsdx.examples.list instead when browsing available examples.

id.description: Official example id or filename, e.g. 'basic', 'tutorial-basic', 'intermediate', 'xg5000-demo-kit', 'advanced', 'library-advanced', 'carwash', 'carwash-continuous', 'st-conditions-v2', 'robot-assembly-cell-v2', 'status-indicator-cell-v2'

buildShow.description: When true, generate a self-contained 3D Build Show + AAS offline viewer resourceUri for this official example

buildShowOptions.description: Optional dsdx-build-show/1.0 configuration object when buildShow is true

aspectPreset.description: Optional 3D Build Show viewport preset when buildShow is true: 'landscape-16x9' | 'shorts-9x16' | 'square-1x1'

includeHtml.description: Whether to inline UTF-8 HTML text in artifacts when buildShow is true (default: false)

tools.name: dsdx.library.search
tools.description: Search and count individual 3D equipment models in the DualSoft Public 3D Library (/ui/library/), returning modelCount, industrial category totals, usage rights, and SHA-256 pinned viewer/GLB/ZIP/DS2 links (DISPLAY_PREVIEW, keyless). Filter with optional q (equivalent aliases: query, search, keyword) and category, and paginate with limit (default 20, clamped to 1..200) and offset/page; public responses are subject to rate limits. Use to find equipment IDs before inspecting one model with dsdx.library.get; use dsdx.scene.catalog instead only for provider-level 3D catalog diagnostics.

q.description: Optional equipment keyword query (e.g. '로봇', '컨베이어', 'clamp', 'turntable'); omit or '' to count and list all approved 3D models

category.description: Optional industrial category filter (e.g. 'A 공통 자동화와 가공', 'B 이송 물류와 포장', 'E 자동차모빌리티', 'L 반도체'; call with {} first to view all categories and counts)

limit.description: Maximum items to return in items[] (1..200, default: 20; values above 200 are clamped to 200; modelCount and total always report the full count)

offset.description: Pagination offset into matching items (0..10000, default: 0)

page.description: Optional 1-based page number shorthand for offset = (page - 1) * limit when offset is omitted

tools.name: dsdx.library.get
tools.description: Inspect one equipment model in the DualSoft Public 3D Library by id (equivalent aliases: assetId, modelId, model_id, slug; id takes precedence), returning dimensions, units, joints, semantic ports, usage rights, SHA-256 download links, and optional verified .ds2 source (DISPLAY_PREVIEW, keyless). Omitting id returns the default starter asset 'b01-01-belt-conveyor' with fallback=true; set view='summary' (default) for compact metadata or 'full' for complete node/binding trees, and includeDs2=true for source text. Use after dsdx.library.search to inspect a chosen model; use dsdx.library.search to browse or filter equipment.

id.description: Approved 3D library model ID (e.g. 'a01-01-six-axis-robot', 'b01-01-belt-conveyor'; optional: omitting returns starter asset 'b01-01-belt-conveyor' with fallback=true; call dsdx.library.search to browse all approved IDs)

asset_type_id.description: Snake_case alias for id (matches search result asset_type_id)

view.description: Response detail level: 'summary' (compact <10KB bounds, joints, ports, links; recommended for multi-asset layout planning) | 'kinematics' (adds initialState & jointBindings) | 'full' (default on dsdx.library.get; includes complete scene nodes & frames)

includeDs2Source.description: Whether to include verified .ds2 (DSLText) source inline in ds2Source (default: true for 'full', false for 'summary'/'kinematics')

tools.name: dsdx.scene.catalog
tools.description: Inspect configured 3D device library providers (DualSoft public, customer private, local air-gapped) for provider-level catalog readiness, version pins, and asset resolution (DSDX-3D-PROVIDER-1). Pass action='list' (default) with optional category, q/keyword, and limit (clamped to 1..200), or action='resolve' with assetTypeId/id to verify provider resolution. Use for provider-level 3D registry diagnostics rather than browsing individual public models; use dsdx.library.search and dsdx.library.get for DualSoft Public 3D Library equipment discovery.

query.description: Search query by assetTypeId, label, or category (e.g. 'conveyor', '로봇', '검사기')

limit.description: Maximum catalog search results (1..200; default 200; values above 200 are clamped to 200). Narrow query/provider to find other devices.

provider_id.description: Snake_case alias for providerId (matches catalog search output)

asset_type_id.description: Snake_case alias for assetTypeId (matches catalog search output)

packageId.description: Exact package identity from catalog resolve (sha256 digest)

package_id.description: Snake_case alias for packageId (matches catalog search output)

release_version.description: Snake_case alias for releaseVersion (matches catalog search output)

category.description: Optional device category or role filter (exact/substring match against provider taxonomy such as 'A 공통 자동화와 가공', 'B 이송 물류와 포장', or role keyword 'Robot'/'Conveyor'/'Buffer'/'Inspector'/'Actuator')

expectedSourceSha256.description: Expected UTF-8 LF normalized source SHA-256 digest

expectedDeliverySha256.description: Expected exact delivery byte SHA-256 digest

tools.name: dsdx.plc.formats
tools.description: List the static catalog of PLC vendors and project file formats supported by DS Studio's local PLC reverse-engineering pipeline (first release: LS ELECTRIC XG5000 .xgwx to DS2 v2 and IDTA 01005 v3.0.1 AASX). Filter the catalog with optional vendor, extension, or filter parameters (equivalent aliases: vendorHint, ext, query, q). Use to check supported PLC formats before running local .xgwx conversion in DS Studio (/play) or Local MCP; this public endpoint is read-only and does not ingest PLC files, and differs from dsdx.library.search (3D models) and dsdx.scene.catalog (3D providers).

filter.description: Substring filter on vendor or format name
